Closest candidate: chunk 0 line 5 "The four composition mechanisms this page names are the move" forward-references Layer 3 (not fully named until chunk 2, lines 42-63) -- stays inside because it is a full noun phrase previewing the PAGE'S OWN structure ("this page names"), not a pronoun/demonstrative standing in for an antecedent the reader must already be tracking, unlike the rule's own violation example. Every later reused term resolves against an earlier same-file naming: chunk 3's PLAN/BUILD/VERIFY/SHIP/OPS headers reuse the Phase axis named in chunk 2's table (line 30); chunk 4's workflow table reuses skill names cataloged in chunk 3; chunk 7 line 155 "Five PLAN-phase skills" and line 156 "`/ship` is the only orchestrator" reuse chunk 2/3 naming directly; chunk 8 line 165 "Dino's four mechanisms" reuses chunk 2 Layer 3. One first-time proper-noun introduction, chunk 7 line 157 "`/aios` is pure routing", defines the term in the same sentence rather than assuming prior context -- not a referent-resolution case at all. No never-named, vague-with-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found anywhere in the body.

grep -niE 'the (opening|prior|earlier|previous) (lecture|module|exercise)|as (covered|discussed)|said (earlier|before)' against the body: 0 hits. This is a standalone supplementary reading with no other-file narrative callback of any kind. Closest line, chunk 6 line 131 "Companion diagrams ship with this doc", names the artifact directly ("this doc") rather than locating it by position -- passes cleanly, and is the file's only self-referential pointer.

`node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/trainings/agentic-engineering-101/supplementary/skill-stacking.md --report` (run this session): all 8 `##` chunks carry 75-321 words / 0-19 bullets of substantive content (TL;DR, the lightest, is a full 75-word paragraph naming all four mechanisms; Workflow shapes and Diagrams are 0-bullet but each is a full table or three captioned images). Every header is a true summary of its own chunk; none contradicted.

Run this session, body scope only (lines 1-173; the one file-wide superlative grep hit -- 'its best guard' at line 193 -- falls in the maintainer/backing tail, outside the body region entirely): (1) `grep -niE 'not [a-z].*\. not [a-z]'` -> 0 hits, no Not-X-Not-Y. (5) No abstraction-noun-stack jargon (closest, 'analysis-to-action ratio', is a named metric, not vague abstraction). (6) No verb triplet with an empty leg.

Chunk 1 (TL;DR) bolds the four composition-mechanism names in one paragraph -- fits 'a law/consolidation slide may carry one handle per law', one slide naming the page's four core mechanisms. Chunk 2's axis table (Scope/Phase/Posture/Enforcement) and mechanism list ('1. Explicit load.' etc, 2-4 words each) and chunk 4's workflow-table row labels (A * Standard feature, etc) are structural table/list row-labels, each an independently <=5-word handle. Chunk 5 'Design principles' bolds a full lead sentence (5-7 words) per numbered entry followed by explanatory prose -- this is the named carve-out for a prose-paragraph lookup entry on a reference/supplementary page ('the bolded lead sentence IS the handle... the cap yields to one full lead sentence per entry'), matching the shape of the compendium's own cited example (claude-code-for-engineers.md's events/hooks entries). No slide bolds a whole multi-sentence block, and no slide exceeds its applicable budget once the lookup-surface waiver is applied.
